newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED V PORTO TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED V PORTO TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup quarter-final first leg match between England's Manchester United and Porto of Portugal:

Manchester United - 1-Peter Schmeichel; 2-Gary Neville, 4-David May, 6-Gary Pallister, 3-Denis Irwin, 10-David Beckham, 5-Ronny Johnsen, 11-Ryan Giggs, 7-Eric Cantona, 9-Andy Cole, 20-Ole Gunnar Solskjaer.
Porto - 24-Hilario; 7-Sergio Conceicao, 22-Jorge Costa, 4-Aloisio, 20-Paulhino Santos, 17-Barroso, 23-Costa, 25-Zlatko Zahovic, 21-Edmilson, 14-Artur, 11-Ljubinko Drulovic.
